normalization.title: Loudness normalization
normalization.offHint: Tracks play as they are in the files.
normalization.trackHint: Every track is levelled by its ReplayGain tag, so tracks of different albums sound equally loud. Tracks without the tag play as they are.
normalization.albumHint: Tracks are levelled by the ReplayGain of their album, which keeps the differences between the tracks of an album; a track without an album tag uses its own. Tracks without tags play as they are.
artistPhotos.title: Artist photos
artistPhotos.on: The photos of the artists come from Deezer. To find them, the names of the artists in your library are sent to Deezer. The photos are kept on this computer. They belong to Deezer and to their rights holders.
artistPhotos.off: The names of your artists are not sent anywhere. The photos that were downloaded stay.
radioSources.title: Radio and covers
radioSources.text: Stations come from radio-browser.info, a directory that anyone can add stations to; Tunelle does not run, check or endorse them. The stream and the logo of a station are loaded from the servers of the station. When a station gives no cover for the song it announces, the title of the song is sent to MusicBrainz to find one, and the Cover Art Archive serves it. Tunelle is not affiliated with radio-browser.info, Deezer or MusicBrainz. More: koeroesi86.github.io/tunelle/privacy.html
watchFolders.title: Watch library folders
watchFolders.on: Songs that are added to, changed in or removed from your library folders are picked up a moment later, without a rescan. The folders are also looked at every few minutes and when you come back to the window, which covers network and removable drives and big libraries. A drive that is back is scanned.
watchFolders.off: The library folders are not watched or looked at while the app runs. Use Rescan to pick up changes; they are also looked for when the app starts and when a drive is back.

about.automatic.off: Tunelle does not check when it starts. Check for updates here, the update is installed when you restart.
